content: The function CanTrcv_GetTrcvSystemData shall read the configuration/status of the CAN transceiver and store the read data in the out p a- rameter TrcvSysData . If this is successful, E_OK shall be returned. Hint: This API can be invoked through diagnostic services or during initialization to deter mine the transceiver status and its availability. Note: Currently an agreement on the parameter set for the transceiver HW specific a- tion has not been reached. For this reason, the diagnostic data is now returned as a uint32 (as stored in the transceiver re gisters). When a definitive and standard p a- rameter set is defined, a data structure may be defined for abstracting the diagnostic data.
